says: In next/, main's ticket 1076 files in libfabrika import Effect by name from the barrel, against 0577's namespace form for libraries: settings/App.ts:8 (Schema), settings/Load.ts:8 (Effect, FileSystem, Path) and settings/App.test.ts:21-22 (Effect, Exit, FileSystem, Layer, Path, PlatformError, Schema, and Digest from effect/crypto).
proof: git show 87e9b955b79bb973d9e9ef044cb1b909926f71f9:next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/App.ts line 8 reads `import { Schema } from "effect";`, the same in commit 19cc78544; .decisions/0577-libraries-namespace-programs-barrel-imports.md says next/packages/* use `import * as X from "effect/X"`. The settings folder holds no preferNamespaceImport lock, so pnpm typecheck passes.
cost: The folder's namespace lock (E61) gets 12 more names to convert, and each new settings file copies the barrel form.
